_README: EVERY user-facing string in the product lives in this file. If you are adding text a person will read, add a key here and reference it — do not write it into a component. This file is also the answer to 'where does that word come from?', which is otherwise hard: strings assembled by code are invisible to search. TRAPS THAT HAVE ACTUALLY BITTEN, each more than once: (1) getTranslations() without a locale renders English inside an otherwise translated page — always pass { locale: params.locale, namespace }, adding params to the page signature if absent; not-found.tsx is the sole exception, since Next passes it no params, so it reads getLocale(). (2) Module-level constants (STEPS, TYPES, STATUS_STYLES, TABS) are evaluated at import where no translator exists — store labelKey and resolve at render. (3) Module-level FUNCTIONS have the same problem and cannot use hooks either; pass the translator in as an argument (see timeAgo in NotificationCenter). (4) Helpers that return finished English prose cannot be translated by their caller — return a key plus its values instead (see getDepositCopy and AllowanceReason). (5) A map or callback parameter named `t` silently shadows the translator. (6) Raw Prisma enums rendered with .toLowerCase() or .replace(/_/g,' ') stay English — use getEnumLabeller and add the values under `enum`. (7) Dates: toLocaleDateString('en-RW') pins dates to English; use lib/dates.ts, which carries real month names for all four locales. Also watch for ternaries, pluralising conditionals, and title-case text rendered uppercase by CSS — grepping the visible text finds none of them. Locale files other than en.json may be partial; missing keys fall back to English per key, which is why English must stay complete.

about.metaDescription: Why ZuriDrive exists and how we handle other people's cars and money.
about.title: About ZuriDrive
about.intro: Renting a car in Rwanda should be as simple as booking a room — and as safe for the person handing over the keys.
about.problemTitle: The problem we set out to fix
about.problemP1: There are plenty of cars in Rwanda sitting still. There are plenty of people who need one for a weekend, a business trip, or a month. What has been missing is a way to put the two together where both sides feel safe.
about.problemP2: An owner handing over their car worries about damage, about who is actually driving, and about getting paid. A renter worries about being overcharged, about a car that is not what the photos showed, and about a deposit that never comes back. ZuriDrive exists to make both of those worries boring.
about.trustTitle: How we try to be trustworthy
about.trustIntro: These are the principles the platform is actually built on.
about.trust1: A deposit is not our money. It is held separately from the rental fee, we take no commission on it, and every movement of it is recorded. It goes back to the renter unless there is evidence supporting a claim.
about.trust2: Financial records are append-only. When something is wrong we correct it by writing a new entry, never by quietly editing an old one. The books are reconciled against two arithmetic identities that have to hold at all times.
about.trust3: Evidence beats opinion. Both parties photograph the car before and after. When there is a dispute we decide on what the photos and timestamps show, not on who argues hardest.
about.trust4: Nobody profits from letting the other side down. A renter who cancels at the last minute compensates the owner. An owner who cancels keeps nothing, ever.
about.trust5: A booking already paid for is protected. If an owner's subscription lapses, cars with upcoming trips stay listed. We will not strand a renter over a billing problem that has nothing to do with them.
about.paysTitle: Built for how Rwanda actually pays
about.paysP1: Sign-in is by phone number and SMS code, because that is what everyone has. Payment is MTN Mobile Money or bank transfer with proof, because that is how money moves here. Prices are in Rwandan francs and handled as whole numbers — no rounding errors quietly eating someone's earnings.

cookies.metaDescription: The small number of cookies ZuriDrive uses, and why.
cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: We use very few. None of them track you.
cookies.shortP1: ZuriDrive sets no advertising cookies and no analytics cookies. We do not embed Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, or any similar tracker. There is no consent banner on this site because there is nothing to consent to — the only cookies we set are the ones required to keep you signed in.
cookies.ddSession: Keeps you signed in as you move between pages. Without it you would have to re-enter your code on every screen. It is removed when you sign out.
cookies.ddSecurity: A short-lived value that lets us verify a form was submitted from our own site, which is how we stop other sites acting on your behalf without your knowledge.
cookies.ddReturn: Remembers which page you were trying to reach when you were asked to sign in, so we can send you back there afterwards.
cookies.setP1: All three are strictly necessary: the site cannot function without them, and under Rwandan and comparable data protection rules they do not require opt-in consent.
cookies.thirdP1: Photos are served from Cloudinary and payments are authorised on MTN's systems. Those providers may set their own cookies on their own domains when your browser fetches an image or completes a payment. We do not control those and we cannot read them.
cookies.offP1: Your browser can block cookies, but blocking ours means you will not be able to sign in — which makes booking a car, or managing a listing, impossible.
cookies.offP2pre: If we ever add a non-essential cookie, we will update this page and ask for your consent before setting it. See the
cookies.offP2post: for how we handle the rest of your data.

help.metaDescription: Answers on deposits, cancellations, payouts and disputes on ZuriDrive.
help.title: Help Centre
help.intro: The questions people actually ask, answered plainly.
help.a1: It covers damage, missing fuel or a late return. It is not part of the rental price and we take no commission from it.
help.q2: When do I get it back?
help.a2: After the trip is completed and both parties have confirmed the return. If nobody raises a problem, it is released in full.
help.q3: The owner is claiming against my deposit. Now what?
help.a3: They have to show evidence. You can open a dispute, add your own photos and explanation, and a person will decide. Your before-trip photos are usually the thing that settles it — which is why taking them matters.
help.a4: No. It goes back to you, or to the owner as compensation after a substantiated claim or a late cancellation. It never becomes our revenue.
help.a5: Cancel outside the cancellation window — currently 24 hours before pick-up — and you get everything back, rental and deposit. Cancel inside it and the owner keeps a share of the deposit, currently 50%. Your rental fee is always returned in full.
help.q6: Why is there a fee at all?
help.a6: The owner turned away other bookings for those dates. A cancellation the night before usually means the car earns nothing that weekend.
help.q7: I think the fee is unfair.
help.a7: Dispute it from the booking page. Give a reason and attach evidence — messages from the owner, a medical document, whatever supports you. If we find in your favour the whole deposit is returned.
help.q8: What if the owner cancels on me?
help.a8: You get a full refund and they keep nothing. That is true whenever they cancel.
help.q9: Do I have to take them?
help.a9: You are strongly advised to. They are the evidence we use in a dispute. Without your own set, you are relying on the other party's.
help.a10: They are deleted automatically a few days after the trip ends — currently three. Photos attached to an open dispute are kept until it is resolved.
help.a11: MTN Mobile Money, or bank transfer with proof of payment. With MoMo you approve a prompt on your phone. With bank transfer our finance team confirms it, usually within a few hours.
help.q12: My money left my account but the booking is not confirmed.
help.a12post: with your booking reference and the MoMo transaction ID, and we will reconcile it.
help.a14: A commission on the rental — currently 20%. Nothing from the deposit. The rate is fixed when a booking is made, so a later change never alters bookings you have already taken.
help.a15: Earnings become payable once the trip completes and the return is confirmed. You request a payout from your dashboard and we send it to the MoMo number or bank account on your profile.
help.q16: What happens if my subscription lapses?
help.a16: Listings above the free allowance are hidden, and you lose priority placement and the verified badge. Cars with an active or upcoming booking stay live — we will not strand someone who has already paid. Renewing puts back exactly the cars we hid, and leaves any car you paused yourself paused.
help.q17: Do I lose days if I renew early?
help.a17: No. A renewal adds a full period on top of what is left, so renewing early costs you nothing.
help.a18: We aim to reply within 24 hours, or 4 hours on Premium. The queue is ordered by which ticket is closest to missing its target, so a long-waiting standard ticket is never stuck behind a stream of newer priority ones.
help.stuckPre: Owners can open a ticket from
help.stuckPost: — and if a trip is in progress and something has gone wrong, call rather than email.

privacy.metaDescription: How ZuriDrive collects, uses and protects your personal data in Rwanda.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: What we collect, why we collect it, and what you can ask us to do with it.
privacy.s1p1: ZuriDrive is a car rental marketplace operating in Rwanda. We connect people who want to rent a car with the owners of those cars. Renters currently pay owners directly at handover — ZuriDrive does not process rental payments or hold deposits.
privacy.s1p2: For the purposes of Law No. 058/2021 relating to the protection of personal data and privacy, ZuriDrive is the data controller for the information described here. You can reach us at .
privacy.s2intro: We only collect what a rental actually requires.
privacy.s2dd1: Your phone number (this is how you sign in), and optionally your name, email address and profile photo.
privacy.s2dt2: Identity documents — we do not collect these
privacy.s2dd2: We do not ask for, or store, your national ID number, your driving licence number, or a photo of either. You confirm at checkout that you hold a valid licence, and the owner checks your documents in person before handing over the car. We record only that the check happened and what the owner concluded — never the documents themselves. Storing them would make us a target worth attacking, and would prove very little: an uploaded photo says nothing about who actually turns up.
privacy.s2dd3: Your MTN MoMo number, or your bank name, account name and account number — used solely to pay you what you have earned.
privacy.s2dd4: Dates, pick-up and drop-off locations, the price agreed, and the status of the trip.
privacy.s2dd5: Photos taken by both parties at the start and end of a trip. These exist to settle disputes about damage and are deleted automatically — see section 5.
privacy.s2dd6: ZuriDrive does not currently process payments for rentals. You pay the owner directly at handover, so we hold no record of that transaction beyond what the booking itself says was agreed. Owners pay us a subscription, and for that we keep the amount, the method and a reference. We never see a PIN or full card details.
privacy.s2dd7: Support tickets you open, any files you attach, and a log of the SMS messages we send you (recipient, content and delivery status) so we can prove what was sent and investigate failures.
privacy.s2dd8: Ratings and written reviews you leave after a trip.
privacy.s2end: We do not track your location in the background, and we do not buy personal data from third parties.
privacy.s3li1: To run a booking — matching you with a car, confirming payment, and telling both sides what is happening.
privacy.s3li2: To record that identity was checked — so there is evidence an owner saw a licence before handing over their car, without us holding the document.
privacy.s3li3: To settle disputes — condition photos and trip records are the evidence we use when parties disagree about damage, fuel or lateness.
privacy.s3li4: To bill owners for their subscription — the plan that lets them list cars.
privacy.s3li5: To meet legal and tax obligations — financial records are retained as Rwandan law requires.
privacy.s3end: We do not sell your personal data, and we do not use it to train advertising profiles.
privacy.s4intro: Only what is necessary, and only to parties who need it to deliver the service:
privacy.s4li1: The other party to your booking. An owner sees the renter's name and phone number for a confirmed trip, and checks their documents in person at handover. A renter sees the owner's name and phone number. Neither sees the other's payout details.
privacy.s4li2: A payment provider — once ZuriDrive begins processing rental payments. Today it does not, and no payment data leaves us because none is collected.
privacy.s4li3: Africa's Talking — to deliver SMS, where SMS is configured. Sign-in uses a password, so most accounts never trigger a message at all.
privacy.s4li5: Rwandan authorities — where we are legally required to disclose, or where it is necessary to investigate a crime such as vehicle theft.
privacy.s4end: Some of these providers process data outside Rwanda. Where that happens we rely on their contractual data-protection commitments.
privacy.s5li1: Condition photos are deleted automatically a few days after a trip ends — the exact window is set in the platform settings and is currently three days. Photos attached to an open dispute are held until the dispute is resolved.
privacy.s5li2: Financial records — owner subscription payments, and any rental payments once we begin processing them — are kept for as long as tax and accounting law requires. These are append-only: we correct an error by writing a new entry, never by editing or deleting the old one.
privacy.s5li3: Your account is kept while it is open. If you close it we remove your profile, but we keep the financial and trip records tied to completed bookings, because the other party to those trips has a legitimate interest in them and we have legal obligations of our own.
privacy.s5li4: SMS logs are kept for troubleshooting and dispute evidence.
privacy.s6intro: Under Rwandan data protection law you can ask us to:
privacy.s6li1: tell you what data we hold about you, and give you a copy;
privacy.s6li3: delete your data, where we are not required to keep it for legal or accounting reasons;
privacy.s6li4: stop using it for a particular purpose;
privacy.s6li5: complain to the National Cyber Security Authority if you think we have handled it improperly.
privacy.s6end: Email <mail></mail> and we will respond within 30 days. We may ask you to confirm your identity first — we are not going to hand your records to someone who merely claims to be you.
privacy.s7p1: Passwords, where you set one, are hashed and never stored in a readable form. Sign-in codes expire and lock out after repeated failed attempts. Access to admin tools is restricted by role, and privileged actions are written to an audit log that records who did what and when.
privacy.s7p2: No system is perfectly secure. If a breach affects your personal data we will notify you and the relevant authority as the law requires.
privacy.s8pre: We use a small number of strictly necessary cookies — mainly to keep you signed in. See the
privacy.s9p1: If we change this policy we will update the date at the top, and for anything significant we will tell you directly. Continuing to use ZuriDrive after a change means you accept the updated policy.

terms.metaDescription: The agreement between you, ZuriDrive, and the other party to your booking.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: What you agree to when you rent a car, or list one, on ZuriDrive.
terms.s1p1: ZuriDrive is a marketplace. We connect people who want to rent a car with the owners of those cars.
terms.s1p2: We do not currently process payments or hold deposits. The renter pays the owner directly at handover, on terms the two of them agree. Our revenue comes from the subscription owners pay to list their cars. Sections 4 and 5 describe how payments and cancellation fees will work once we do begin processing them; until then those arrangements are between you and the other party.
terms.s1p3: We do not own the vehicles listed here and we are not the ones renting them to you. The rental contract is between the renter and the owner. What we are responsible for is running the platform honestly: describing cars accurately, applying these terms consistently, and judging disputes fairly on the evidence.
terms.s2p1: You must be 18 or over. To rent you need a valid driving licence and a national ID or passport. We do not ask you to upload them — you confirm at checkout that you hold them, and the owner checks them in person before handing over the car. Turning up without them is grounds for the owner to refuse. To list a car you must be its legal owner or have the owner's written authority.
terms.s2p2: You are responsible for what happens on your account. Keep your password to yourself.
terms.s3p1: A booking is confirmed when the owner accepts it. Until then the car is not held for you. Payment is arranged directly with the owner — agree how and when before you travel to collect the car.
terms.s3p2: If the owner does not respond within the response window, the booking is confirmed automatically so you are not left waiting indefinitely. If the owner declines, nothing is owed.
terms.s4p1: None of this applies yet — today you pay the owner directly. It describes the arrangement that will take effect when ZuriDrive begins processing payments, and we will tell you before it does.
terms.s4p2: Rental fee. Shown in full before you pay. ZuriDrive keeps a commission from it — currently 20% — and the rest goes to the owner. The rate that applies to your booking is fixed at the moment you book; a later change never alters a booking already made.
terms.s4p3: Security deposit. Held separately from the rental fee. It is not income, we take no commission on it, and it is returned to you unless there is a substantiated claim against it. Every movement of a deposit is recorded.
terms.s4p4: Refunds are returned to the payment method you used, normally within 1–3 business days once we have issued them.
terms.s5p1: While payments are settled directly, cancellation terms are between you and the other party. The rules below take effect when ZuriDrive begins holding deposits.
terms.s5p2: Cancel early and you pay nothing. If you cancel outside the cancellation window, your rental fee and your full deposit are returned.
terms.s5p3: Cancel late and a fee applies. If you cancel within the cancellation window before pick-up — currently 24 hours — we keep a share of your deposit, currently 50%, and pass it to the owner. They have turned away other bookings for those dates. Your rental fee is still returned in full; the fee only ever comes out of the deposit.
terms.s5p4: If the owner cancels, they keep nothing, whenever they do it. You get everything back. An owner must never profit from pulling out.
terms.s5p5: You can dispute a cancellation fee. If you think it is unfair — the owner pushed you into cancelling, the car was not available, there was an emergency — you can challenge it with a reason and evidence, and a person will review it. If we find for you, the whole deposit is returned.
terms.s6p1: Photograph the car before you drive and after you return it. Both parties do this. These photos are the evidence we use if there is a dispute about damage, and they are deleted a few days after the trip ends. If you skip them, you are relying on the other party's photos alone.
terms.s6p2: Return the vehicle on time, in the condition you received it, with the fuel level the listing requires. You are responsible for traffic fines, tolls and penalties incurred while the car is with you.
terms.s6p3: Do not sub-let the car, use it for a criminal purpose, drive it under the influence, or take it outside Rwanda without written permission from the owner.
terms.s7p1: If an owner claims against a deposit, they must provide evidence. Either party can open a dispute, and we decide on what we can see: condition photos, timestamps, messages and trip records.
terms.s7p2: Our decision determines what happens to the deposit. It does not stop either party pursuing the matter through the Rwandan courts, and it is not a substitute for insurance.
terms.s8p1: Your vehicle must be roadworthy, legally registered and insured for the use it is being rented for. Listings must be accurate — the photos must be of the actual car.
terms.s8p2: Subscription plans. Plans are billed for 30 days at a time and do not auto-renew by taking your money without asking; you renew deliberately. Renewing early adds a full period on top of the days you have left, so you lose nothing by doing it. If a plan lapses, listings above your free allowance are hidden — but any car with an active or upcoming booking stays live, because someone has paid for that trip. Renewing restores exactly the cars we hid.
terms.s8p3: Payouts. Your earnings become payable once a trip completes. Keep your payout details accurate — we are not liable for money sent to a wrong number you gave us.
terms.s9Title: What we are not responsible for
terms.s9p1: We are a marketplace, and we are honest about the limits of that. We are not liable for the mechanical condition of a vehicle, an owner's or renter's conduct, accidents, injury, theft, or losses arising from a trip itself. Those sit with the parties to the rental and their insurers.
terms.s9p2: We are responsible for handling your money correctly, keeping accurate records, and applying these terms consistently. Nothing here limits liability that Rwandan law does not allow us to limit.
terms.s10p1: We can suspend or remove an account for fraud, repeated cancellations, unsafe conduct, false listings, or abuse of another user. Where we do, money already owed to you is still paid — suspension is not a mechanism for keeping your earnings.
terms.s11p1: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Rwanda, and the courts of Rwanda have jurisdiction over any dispute arising from them.

howItWorks.heroTitle: Everything you need to know about ZuriDrive
howItWorks.heroSub: Whether you're renting a car or listing yours, we've built ZuriDrive to be transparent, secure, and straightforward.
howItWorks.r1Body: Browse cars by pickup location, date range, and rental type (daily, weekly, or monthly). Filter by car category, transmission, price range, and whether you need a driver. Featured and verified cars appear first.
howItWorks.r2Body: Each listing shows the full pricing breakdown — daily in-city, outside city, weekly, and monthly rates. You'll see the fuel policy, damage deposit, available pickup locations, and the owner's response time badge.
howItWorks.r3Body: Returning users are pre-filled. First-timers enter their name and phone number and pick a password. Your account is created as you book — no separate signup step.
howItWorks.r4Body: Choose MTN Mobile Money (USSD push to your phone) or bank transfer (upload proof, confirmed by our finance team). Your booking is confirmed only after payment fully clears — never on initiation alone.
howItWorks.r5Body: Your owner confirms within 2 hours (or it auto-confirms). You both upload pre-trip condition photos including the fuel gauge. Return the car, upload post-trip photos, and your deposit is released automatically.
howItWorks.depositCardIntro: The damage deposit is completely separate from your rental payment, and never subject to commission or platform fees.
howItWorks.fuelCardBody: Each car has a clearly stated fuel policy: Full to Full, Same Level, Free Tank, or Owner Handles. The policy is shown prominently on the listing and booking pages — no surprises.
howItWorks.pickupCardBody: Choose from platform-verified locations (airports, hotels), owner custom pickup points, or describe your own location. Maps are always optional — never forced.
howItWorks.o1Body: Set up your owner profile with your name and phone, then add payout details — MTN MoMo or a bank account. Payout details are required before you can list. Then choose your subscription plan: Basic, Pro, or Premium.
howItWorks.o2Body: A guided 5-step form walks you through: basic info, photos (3–10), pricing for all periods, availability calendar, and pickup locations. Save as draft and return anytime. Draft auto-saves every 60 seconds.
howItWorks.o3Body: You get an SMS when a booking request arrives. Accept or reject within 2 hours — if you don't respond, it auto-confirms (great for your response time badge). Set your own cancellation rules.
howItWorks.o4Body: Both you and the renter upload condition photos before and after every trip — exterior, interior, and fuel gauge. Photos are kept for 3 days after completion, then automatically deleted.
howItWorks.o5Body: Once a trip completes, request a payout from your dashboard. Our finance team sends money via MoMo or bank transfer within 24 hours and uploads proof. You keep 80% of every booking.
howItWorks.reviewsCardBody: Only clients who completed a booking for that exact car can leave a review. Ratings cover cleanliness, comfort, value, and owner communication.
howItWorks.disputeCardBody: Either party can raise a dispute. Our team reviews condition photos and fuel gauge records and resolves within 48 hours. Deposit is held until resolved.
howItWorks.photoCardBody: Pre and post-trip photos are required for both parties. Condition photos are stored for 3 days after a completed trip, or until a dispute is fully resolved.

sms.newBookingRequest: ZuriDrive: Hi {owner}, new booking request! {car} - {start, date, medium} to {end, date, medium}. Amount: {amount}. Ref: {reference}. Log in to accept or decline within 2 hours.
sms.paymentConfirmed: ZuriDrive: Payment confirmed! {amount} received for {car}. Ref: {reference}. Your owner will confirm within 2 hours. We'll SMS you.
sms.bookingConfirmedByOwner: ZuriDrive: Great news {client}! {owner} confirmed your {car} booking. Pickup: {start, date, medium}. Ref: {reference}. See your dashboard for details.
sms.bookingRejectedByOwner: ZuriDrive: Sorry {client}, your {car} booking ({reference}) was declined. Reason: {reason}. A full refund will be processed within 24-48 hours.
sms.bookingAutoConfirmed: ZuriDrive: Your {car} booking is confirmed! {client}, pickup on {start, date, medium}. Ref: {reference}. Check your dashboard for owner contact details.
sms.adminCancelledClient: ZuriDrive: Your booking {reference} for {car} has been cancelled by our team. {reason}
sms.adminCancelledClientRefund: ZuriDrive: Your booking {reference} for {car} has been cancelled by our team. {reason} Your deposit of {amount} will be returned within 1-3 business days.
sms.adminCancelledOwner: ZuriDrive: Booking {reference} for your {car} has been cancelled by our team. {reason}
sms.listingLive: ZuriDrive: Your {car} is now live and can be booked. Manage it from your fleet page.
sms.listingSuspended: ZuriDrive: Your {car} listing has been suspended. {reason} Contact support if you'd like to discuss this.
sms.disputeResolvedClientRefund: ZuriDrive: The dispute on booking {reference} has been resolved. {amount} of your deposit is being returned. It should reflect within 1-3 business days.
sms.disputeResolvedClientNone: ZuriDrive: The dispute on booking {reference} has been resolved. Your deposit was awarded to the owner. Contact support if you'd like to discuss this.
sms.disputeResolvedOwnerAward: ZuriDrive: The dispute on {car} ({reference}) has been resolved in your favour. {amount} has been awarded to you.
sms.disputeResolvedOwnerNone: ZuriDrive: The dispute on {car} ({reference}) has been resolved. The deposit was returned to the client.
sms.depositDeducted: ZuriDrive: {amount} has been deducted from your deposit for booking {reference}. {description}
sms.depositDeductedRemainder: ZuriDrive: {amount} has been deducted from your deposit for booking {reference}. {description} The remaining {remaining} will be returned.
sms.payoutSent: ZuriDrive: Your payout of {amount} has been sent to your {method, select, MTN_MOMO {MoMo account} other {bank account}}. It should reflect within 1-3 business days.
sms.payoutFailed: ZuriDrive: We couldn't complete your {amount} payout. {reason} Your earnings are still available - please check your payout details and try again.
sms.adminAccessGranted: ZuriDrive: You've been given admin access. Sign in at {url}/login with this phone number - we'll text you a code.
sms.accountSuspended: ZuriDrive: Your account has been suspended. {reason} Contact support if you believe this is a mistake.
sms.planActive: ZuriDrive: Your {plan} plan is active until {date, date, medium}.
sms.planActiveRelisted: ZuriDrive: Your {plan} plan is active until {date, date, medium}. {count, plural, =1 {# of your cars is back online.} other {# of your cars are back online.}}
sms.planActiveUnlisted: ZuriDrive: Your {plan} plan is active until {date, date, medium}. {count, plural, =1 {# car was unlisted to fit the new plan.} other {# cars were unlisted to fit the new plan.}}
sms.cancelledByClientToOwner: ZuriDrive: {client} cancelled booking {reference} for your {car}. Reason: {reason}
sms.cancelledByOwnerToClient: ZuriDrive: The owner cancelled booking {reference} for the {car}. Reason: {reason}
sms.cancelledByOwnerToClientRefund: ZuriDrive: The owner cancelled booking {reference} for the {car}. Reason: {reason} Your payment of {amount} will be returned within 1-3 business days.
sms.tripCompleteClient: ZuriDrive: Your trip with {car} is complete! Ref: {reference}. Your deposit of {amount} has been released. Please leave a review on your dashboard.
sms.tripCompleteOwner: ZuriDrive: {car} booking {reference} completed. Your earnings will be available for payout request from your dashboard.
sms.returnConfirmedByOther: ZuriDrive: The {role, select, client {client} other {owner}} has confirmed return of {car} ({reference}). Please log in and confirm the return to release the deposit.
sms.disputeOpenedClient: ZuriDrive: A dispute has been opened on booking {reference} ({car}). Our team will review and contact you within 24 hours. The deposit is held pending resolution.
sms.disputeOpenedOwner: ZuriDrive: A dispute has been opened on booking {reference} ({car}). Our team will review and contact you within 24 hours.
sms.tripActiveClient: ZuriDrive: Your trip with {car} is now active! ({reference}). Remember to take pre-trip condition photos before driving. Have a great trip!
sms.tripActiveOwner: ZuriDrive: Booking {reference} for {car} is now active. The client's trip has started.
sms.tripTomorrowClient: ZuriDrive: Reminder - your {car} trip starts tomorrow! Pickup: {pickup}. Ref: {reference}. Don't forget to take condition photos at pickup.
sms.tripTomorrowOwner: ZuriDrive: Reminder - your {car} is being picked up tomorrow. Booking: {reference}. Client: {client}.
sms.autoCompleteClient: ZuriDrive: Your {car} trip ({reference}) is now marked complete. Please leave a review on your dashboard.
sms.autoCompleteClientDeposit: ZuriDrive: Your {car} trip ({reference}) is now marked complete. Your deposit of {amount} has been released. Please leave a review on your dashboard.
sms.autoCompleteOwner: ZuriDrive: Booking {reference} ({car}) has been auto-completed. Your earnings are available for payout request.
sms.photosDeleting: ZuriDrive: Condition photos for your {car} trip ({reference}) will be deleted in 24 hours. Download them from your dashboard if you need them.
sms.autoConfirmedOwner: ZuriDrive: Booking {reference} for your {car} was auto-confirmed because you didn't respond within 2 hours. Please check your dashboard.
sms.subscriptionRenewing: ZuriDrive: Your {plan} subscription ({price}/month) renews in {days, plural, =1 {# day} other {# days}}. Make sure your payment method is up to date.
sms.subscriptionExpiredUnlisted: ZuriDrive: Your {plan} subscription has expired. {count, plural, =1 {# of your cars has} other {# of your cars have}} been unlisted, but any car with a booking stays live. Renew to put them all back.
sms.subscriptionExpiredLive: ZuriDrive: Your {plan} subscription has expired. Your cars stay listed, but you've lost priority placement and can't add new ones until you renew.
sms.depositReleased: ZuriDrive: Your deposit of {amount} for booking {reference} has been released. It will reflect in your account within 1-3 business days.
sms.depositPartialWithheldClient: ZuriDrive: {withheld} of your deposit for booking {reference} has been withheld. {returned} will be returned within 1-3 business days. Reason: {reason}
sms.depositDeductionOwner: ZuriDrive: A deposit deduction of {amount} has been approved for booking {reference}. Contact support for details.
sms.depositFullWithheld: ZuriDrive: Your full deposit of {amount} for booking {reference} has been withheld. Reason: {reason}. Contact support if you wish to dispute this.
sms.bookingRejectedByOwnerNoReason: ZuriDrive: Sorry {client}, your {car} booking ({reference}) was declined by the owner. A full refund will be processed within 24-48 hours.
